海外の合弁・再エネの提携先

relations.text: メロ・アタプ鉱区の連合に20%で参加
relations.text_en: Partner (20%) in the consortium for the Mero and Atapu reservoirs

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The consortia formed by us, in partnership with Shell (20%), acquired the Federal Government's participation of production sharing agreement of the Mero shared reservoir and Atapu shared reservoir.

relations.text: 鉱区の共同取得(42.5%、操業者)
relations.text_en: Co-acquired a block, taking 42.5% as operator

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The transaction was carried out in partnership with TotalEnergies, which also acquired 42.5% and will act as the operator of the block.

companies.name: エクイノール
companies.sub: 石油・ガス(ノルウェー)

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Jaspe block, in partnership with Equinor, and Citrino block.

companies.name: エコペトロル
companies.sub: 石油・ガス(コロンビア)

relations.text: コロンビア沖のGUA-OFF-0鉱区でガスを発見(ペトロブラスが操業)
relations.text_en: Found Colombia's largest offshore gas discovery together (Petrobras operates)

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Acting as operator in partnership with Ecopetrol, efforts in the GUA-OFF-0 block led to the most significant offshore natural gas discovery in Colombia

relations.text: メキシコ湾の合弁MPGOMに20%参加
relations.text_en: Holds 20% in the MPGOM joint venture in the Gulf of Mexico

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: we focus on deepwater fields in the Gulf of Mexico, where we have non-consolidated production from the 20% participation of Petrobras America Inc. in our joint venture with Murphy Exploration & Production Company, the MPGOM LLC.

relations.text: Lightsource bpと陸上再エネで戦略提携(2025年12月)
relations.text_en: Strategic partnership in onshore renewables with Lightsource bp (Dec 2025)

source.label: Petrobras 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2025, we signed an agreement with Lightsource bp to establish a strategic partnership in the onshore renewable energy segment.
